records.setup: Invalid rank/last dimension, Python list/custom object and malformed shape; use source ordering oracle.
records.independent_oracle: Shape validation/access must precede metadata retrieval and numeric conversion. Preserve actual error type/timing per eager/graph/JIT without auto-conversion hiding failures.
records.qualification_rule: No skips, silent casts, host transfer or CPU fallback count as verification.

records.setup: Unique finite scores with known immutable class map for multiple batch rows and top=1/5.
records.independent_oracle: Independent sorted score/index list determines top output tuples, values and label lookup; no file I/O mock can qualify ranking.
records.qualification_rule: No skips, silent casts, host transfer or CPU fallback count as verification.

records.setup: top=0, negative, larger than1000, bool, non-integer and unusual scalar types.
records.independent_oracle: Source slices argsort()[-top:][::-1] without complete explicit top validation. Preserve resulting behavior or error; do not normalize to a preferred convention silently.
records.qualification_rule: No skips, silent casts, host transfer or CPU fallback count as verification.

records.setup: Tied scores, NaNs, infinities, complex/integer/low-precision scores and zero batch.
records.independent_oracle: Tie/NaN/order policy, output score dtype and unsupported domains need exact independent fixtures/differential evidence. Do not infer stable tie behavior from a sort name.
records.qualification_rule: No skips, silent casts, host transfer or CPU fallback count as verification.

records.setup: Cold/warm class cache, wrong hash, failed download/JSON, missing class key and concurrent first calls.
records.independent_oracle: Separate asset bytes/cache/hash/JSON failures from mathematical score validation/top-k and class mapping; preserve process-global cache effects and operation ordering.
records.qualification_rule: No skips, silent casts, host transfer or CPU fallback count as verification.

records.setup: Eager Tensor, graph/symbolic Tensor and requested accelerator placements.
records.independent_oracle: Explicit convert_to_numpy host boundary has unqualified mode/device behavior; no CPU fallback or host-copy implementation counts as accelerator qualification.
records.qualification_rule: No skips, silent casts, host transfer or CPU fallback count as verification.

records.setup: caffe input with labeled RGB channels in 3D/4D, both layouts, float versus integer arrays.
records.independent_oracle: Independent BGR reversal and per-channel mean subtraction; source cast/view/in-place behavior must be tested as alias/mutation classes.
records.qualification_rule: No skips, silent casts, host transfer or CPU fallback count as verification.

records.setup: tf and torch normalization modes with distinct channel values, dtype and layout.
records.independent_oracle: Analytical x/127.5-1 or (x/255-mean)/std fixtures; mode torch is a source spelling, not evidence of PyTorch equivalence.
records.qualification_rule: No skips, silent casts, host transfer or CPU fallback count as verification.

records.setup: Four identity wrappers with arbitrary data_format and x object types.
records.independent_oracle: Exact source returns x; confirm identity/alias/error distinctions independently from imagenet_utils mode validation and model-embedded preprocessing.
records.qualification_rule: No skips, silent casts, host transfer or CPU fallback count as verification.

records.setup: Dynamic imagenet_utils mode/data_format including None/global setting and invalid values.
records.independent_oracle: Preserve selector errors and dispatch between NumPy and tensor branches, including dtype, shape, layout and mutation differences.
records.qualification_rule: No skips, silent casts, host transfer or CPU fallback count as verification.

records.qualification_rule: No skips, silent casts, host transfer or CPU fallback count as verification.
